tei:div.tei:p: na mo ak+ṣo bh+yaḥ 'dir 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor zhig gzhan la phan 'dod kyi bsam pas bri bar bya ste/ de yang*/ rje dge 'dun rgya mtsho/ paṇa chen rin po che sogs kyis rang gi rtsa ba'i bla ma dang rdo rje 'jigs byed byams pa sogs kyi rnal 'byor dang sbyar ba'i 'pho ba du ma zhig gsungs pa ltar/ mi 'khrugs pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang sbyar ba'i 'pho ba'ang shin tu rung bar mthong nas 'di ltar brjod par bya'o/ /de yang rang gis sbyong ba dang 'debs pa'i tshul gnyis kyis bshad na/ dang po ni/ skyabs 'gro sogs sngon du btang nas/ rang gi spyi bor seng khri'i steng du pad zla'i gdan la rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa g.yas sa gnon dang*/ g.yon mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya'i steng na rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsnams pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs pas spras shing*/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa'i spyi bor oṃ/ nas hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros/ rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa la sangs rgyas dang*/ = spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par gyur/ slar yang nas rdo rje sems dpas dbu brgyan par gyur/ skyabs gnas kun 'dus kyi ngo bo rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ /mchod do skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes lan bdun sogs mang du brjod/ rgyas par ni yan lag bdun pa bya/ de nas phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa/ gsol ba 'debs so/ /zhes par bsgyur te mang du brjod la/ rang gi lus kyi drang thad kyi nang rtsa dbu ma mda' smyug tsam zhig mar sna lte 'og dang yar sna tshangs bug tu zug pa/ snying kha'i thad du rang gi rnam shes kyi ngo bo thig le dkar po rgya sran tsam 'phur la khang pa 'od kyi rang bzhin can du gyur par bsams te/ sngar gyi gsol 'debs kyi 'phror/ bcom ldan 'das bdag la zab lam 'pho ba 'byongs par byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ zhes sbyar ba ci nus bya/

mthar/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ thugs ka nas 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu zhig nar gyis byung ste/ rang gi tshangs bug nas zhugs/ rang sems thig ler gsal ba la zug par bsams la/ 'og rlung gyen du 'then pa dag mnyam du hi ka ces brjod pas/ thig le dbu ma'i lam nas yar song ste tshangs bug la zug tsam re byas slar 'bebs/ de ltar re mos byed pa'i tshul gyis zhag bdun nas gsum sogs sbyangs pas rtags 'byung*/ mthar/ rang la thim pas byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa rang 'chi ba'i tshe/ gsol 'debs kyi bar sngar ltar byas pa'i mjug tu/ mngon dga'i zhing du skye bar byin gyis rlob tu gsol/ ces sbyar ba'ang lan mang du brjod pa'i mthar/ hi ka phaṭa/ ces brjod pas/ rnam shes kyi ngo bo thig le de dbu ma'i lam nas yar 'phangs te tshangs bug nas rgyangs kyis byung*/ rgyal ba'i thugs kar thim pas/ de nyid mngon dga'i zhing du byon/ rnam shes thugs nas slar 'thon te/ zhing der skyes par bsam pa mang nyung skabs dang bstun nas bya'o/ /ces pa 'di yang zhing bkod dang smon lam gnyis kyi yan lag tu bshad sgrub ming can gyis sbyar ba'o// // mes po'i shul bzhag las/ co ne grags pa bshad sgrub kyi gsung 'bum/'pho ba'i rnal 'byor bzhugs/ -PAGE 90--PAGE 695--PAGE 89-
